title: A dry spell: the tank runs empty
about: The tank pipes under the bed keep the soil moist from below. See what happens when they are empty, what the page tells you, and how the bed recovers.

steps.title: While the tank has water
steps.why: Soil over a filled tank draws water up by itself: grown plants need no watering from above. The driest planted cell stays near 45 %.

steps.title: The tank is empty and the sun is out
steps.why: A hot week with nobody refilling: the tank is drawn empty and the soil dries. In the twin this takes one click instead of a week.

do.label: Empty the tank and dry the soil

expect.say: {v} notice(s) for you on the page

steps.title: Robot: water from above
steps.why: Without the tank, the page proposes to water the dry cells from above with clean water, each with what its crop wants for a day.

steps.title: You: refill the tank
steps.why: Refilling is a person's job. With water back in the pipes the wick takes over again and the soil climbs back by itself.
